station_name: SANTA MARGARITA LAKE NEAR POZO, CALIF.
township_range_section: NW¼NW¼ sec.8, T.30 S., R.14 E.
notes: The digitized table covers the capacity table, the daily contents grid and the foot rows, so all are counted. Measurements: capacity table 20 elevation/contents pairs = 40 points; daily contents 365 (Oct 31, Nov 30, Dec 31, Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31, Sep 30); row (a) end-of-month elevation 12; row (c) monthly diversion for municipal supply 12 (listed as 'other'; zeros counted) = 429. Summary values: MAX and MIN rows 24, row (b) change in contents 12, CAL YR / WTR YR lines 4 = 40, giving 469. Unsure because the rules do not say how to treat a capacity table and a daily table merged into one, or whether the diversion row is a measurement; resolution given as daily (the capacity part alone would be no_time_series, without dates). Other distances: at left end of dam on Salinas River, 2 miles upstream from Pilitas Creek, 7.5 miles northwest of Pozo. Formerly published as Salinas Reservoir near Pozo.
